pin.title: NorthContinent — Akaren ga Opens in Odori / Red Brick district
pin.description: A new Hokkaido hamburger-steak restaurant with branch-specific curry and stew lunches, dip-style dinners and a meat breakfast plate.
pin.longFormSummary:
A new Hokkaido hamburger-steak restaurant with branch-specific curry and stew lunches, dip-style dinners and a meat breakfast plate.

Complete operator opening caption embedded in own homepage confirms September 1, 2026 soft opening (lunch/dinner); October 3 is grand opening and breakfast start. Two separate later captions independently confirm first service, not only recruitment estimates.
pin.address: North B1F, Urban Net Sapporo Link Tower, 1-4 Kita 1-jo Nishi 5-chome, Chuo-ku, Sapporo
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: Complete operator opening caption embedded in own homepage confirms September 1, 2026 soft opening (lunch/dinner); October 3 is grand opening and breakfast start. Two separate later captions independently confirm first service, not only recruitment estimates.

menus.note: Complete own-homepage embedded operator captions explicitly identify this branch: tomato curry or Saroma pumpkin stew lunch, 150g rice standard or 300g option; beef/pork/chicken blend in lunch steak. Dinner meat choices and four sauces: Hatcho miso/prune demi-glace, grandmother’s sansho-zuke teriyaki, ume/irizake, assorted cheese. Prices are not published in those captions; seven topping names remain unpublished. Do not borrow other branch prices. October20follow-up: exact branch menu photos now verify dinner set prices; see separate transcribed menus below. Lunch prices and unnamed topping list remain unpublished in checked operator captions.
